nodes.label: astro:assets Image Pipeline
nodes.rationale: WebP/AVIF conversion, srcset and automatic dimensions for good LCP/CLS.

nodes.label: Astro + Strict TypeScript
nodes.rationale: Static HTML by default for max speed and local SEO; JS only in islands where needed.

nodes.label: Environment Variables (Keystatic OAuth, PUBLIC_SITE_URL)
nodes.rationale: Secrets live in Vercel, never in the repo; registering a domain only changes PUBLIC_SITE_URL and DNS.

nodes.label: Hero Interaction & Accessibility (keyboard, swipe, aria-live, #hash deep link)
nodes.norm_label: hero interaction & accessibility (keyboard, swipe, aria-live, #hash deep link)
nodes.rationale: Canvas is aria-hidden; information lives in text announced via aria-live polite.

nodes.label: Hero Animation Timeline (entry, change, idle, reduced-motion)
nodes.norm_label: hero animation timeline (entry, change, idle, reduced-motion)
nodes.rationale: Time-based (not frame-based) animation so it finishes on time on slow devices; prefers-reduced-motion disables entry/idle and makes changes instant.

nodes.label: ImageAsset (src + mandatory alt)
nodes.rationale: alt is mandatory for accessibility and SEO.

nodes.label: Keystatic CMS (GitHub mode)
nodes.rationale: Content versioned in the repo, no database or cost; admin panel at /keystatic behind GitHub login; local storage in development.

nodes.label: Lead Capture Objective (WhatsApp/Instagram)
nodes.rationale: Institutional site for Crisur Polarizados (Godoy Cruz, Mendoza) exists to generate inquiries; polarizado is the brand axis, other services are complementary.

nodes.label: Local SEO (JSON-LD LocalBusiness, sitemap, Open Graph)
nodes.norm_label: local seo (json-ld localbusiness, sitemap, open graph)

nodes.label: Non-Functional Requirements (Lighthouse>=95, LCP<2.5s, WCAG 2.1 AA, mobile-first)
nodes.norm_label: non-functional requirements (lighthouse>=95, lcp<2.5s, wcag 2.1 aa, mobile-first)
nodes.rationale: Most traffic arrives from Instagram on mobile.

nodes.label: render-posters script (npm run posters)
nodes.rationale: Generates posters with headless Chrome/Edge located via CHROME_PATH env var.

nodes.label: Service Roulette (locales, autos, hogares ring at 120 deg)
nodes.norm_label: service roulette (locales, autos, hogares ring at 120 deg)
nodes.rationale: Fixed cyclic order; selecting a lateral diorama rotates the ring the shortest way.

nodes.label: Showroom 3D Hero
nodes.rationale: Replaces the 2D switcher; copy on top, showroom zone below, WebGL canvas covers the whole stage.

nodes.label: Vercel Hosting (@astrojs/vercel)
nodes.rationale: Automatic deploy on push; Keystatic commits trigger rebuilds. Published on *.vercel.app until a domain is registered.

nodes.label: Framing Zone via setViewOffset
nodes.rationale: Camera frames the featured diorama inside the showroom zone so it never sits under the text or CTA.

nodes.label: wa.me Prefilled WhatsApp Contact Links
nodes.rationale: No backend and no personal data to store.

nodes.label: No Hardcoded Credentials / Use Env Vars
nodes.norm_label: no hardcoded credentials / use env vars

nodes.label: SDD Methodology (Specification-Driven Development)
nodes.rationale: Never code blindly: analyze/design first, then specify signatures, models and exceptions, then implement; ask about ambiguous edge cases before coding.

nodes.label: Specific Exception Handling / Fail-Fast Rule
nodes.rationale: No generic try/catch; catch specific exceptions and handle errors at design level (fail-fast).

nodes.label: Token Economy & Communication Style
nodes.rationale: Maximize context efficiency: no intro/closing chatter, direct answers, bullet explanations of why (not what), never repeat unchanged code.

nodes.label: Argentina WhatsApp Mobile '9' Prefix
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp in Argentina requires 9 after the country code: +54 261 625-6467 is stored as 5492616256467.

nodes.label: Build-Time Phone Validation (fail-fast)
nodes.rationale: An invalid number breaks the build instead of publishing broken links.

nodes.label: Deferred Three.js Chunk Loading
nodes.rationale: Dynamic import in requestIdleCallback after first render keeps initial JS ~5 KB; 3D chunk ~150 KB gzip; pixelRatio caps, paused render off-viewport, precompiled shaders, full dispose().

nodes.label: Empty Content Edge Cases
nodes.rationale: Empty gallery hides home highlights and shows an Instagram CTA; empty address/hours are omitted from footer and JSON-LD so no empty fields reach Google.

nodes.label: No Prices Principle
nodes.rationale: Everything is resolved by inquiry, so every section ends in a WhatsApp CTA.

nodes.label: No Rigid Film/Tint Catalog Principle
nodes.rationale: They work with all films and darkness levels; the site explains options generally and routes to a conversation.

nodes.label: Showroom Design Principles (one memorable moment, glass is the theme, red is light, nothing covers the product)
nodes.norm_label: showroom design principles (one memorable moment, glass is the theme, red is light, nothing covers the product)
nodes.rationale: The 3D showroom is the only memorable moment; glass is rendered physically (PBR) rather than via UI glassmorphism; generic defaults (uppercase eyebrows, separators, arrows, thin serif) removed.

nodes.label: Static Poster Fallback
nodes.rationale: PNG posters rendered from the same 3D scene are shown when WebGL is unavailable, the 3D chunk fails, or JS is disabled; not downloaded when 3D is active.

nodes.label: Static Render + On-Demand Routes for Keystatic
nodes.norm_label: static render + on-demand routes for keystatic
nodes.rationale: Public pages are prerendered; only the admin panel needs server endpoints (GitHub OAuth).

nodes.label: 3D Service Category Carousel
nodes.rationale: Three pedestals arranged in an arc with one foregrounded: a rotating carousel pattern where each pedestal is a service category (autos, commercial, residential).

nodes.label: Autos Hero Poster
nodes.rationale: Static 2160x743 render of the 3D hero scene with the car category in focus; likely used as a poster/fallback frame while the interactive 3D hero loads or on low-power devices.

nodes.label: Silver Sedan on Central Pedestal
nodes.rationale: Low-poly silver sedan with dark tinted windows and plate 'AF 026 CR' centered on a red-glowing platform; the active/selected carousel item.

nodes.label: Commercial Storefront on Side Pedestal
nodes.rationale: Glass-front commercial building on the left background platform, representing the commercial film category (inactive carousel item).

nodes.label: Residential House on Side Pedestal
nodes.rationale: Modern two-story house on the right background platform, representing the residential film category (inactive carousel item).

nodes.label: Dark Background with Red Neon Glow Style
nodes.norm_label: dark background with red neon glow style
nodes.rationale: Near-black backdrop with red rim-lit pedestals and red radial floor glow; brand accent color used to highlight the active item.

nodes.label: Sedan Car Model (Automotive Tinting, side slot)
nodes.norm_label: sedan car model (automotive tinting, side slot)

nodes.label: Low-poly Modern Two-Story House (Residential Window Film)
nodes.norm_label: low-poly modern two-story house (residential window film)

nodes.label: Commercial Storefront Model (Business Glazing, side slot)
nodes.norm_label: commercial storefront model (business glazing, side slot)

nodes.label: Dark Background with Red Neon Glow Brand Palette
nodes.norm_label: dark background with red neon glow brand palette

nodes.label: 3D Pedestal Carousel Layout (center focus, flanking previews)
nodes.norm_label: 3d pedestal carousel layout (center focus, flanking previews)

nodes.label: 3D Podium Carousel Hero Layout (dark bg, red neon rings)
nodes.norm_label: 3d podium carousel hero layout (dark bg, red neon rings)
nodes.rationale: Static poster frame of a 3D hero carousel: active service centered and enlarged on a glowing red podium, other services receded to the sides. Likely used as a poster/fallback image while the WebGL scene loads or when 3D is unavailable.

nodes.label: Circular Badge Container with White Ring
nodes.norm_label: circular badge container with white ring

nodes.label: Archivo Variable Typography
nodes.rationale: One family, two widths: wide heavy display for automotive language, normal width for text.

nodes.label: Brand Palette (tinted-glass graphite + logo red)
nodes.rationale: Background evokes tinted glass (bluish graphite, not flat black); logo red #e3262b used as light and CTA; contrast ratios chosen for WCAG AA.

nodes.label: Design Tokens (src/styles/tokens.css)
nodes.rationale: Single file of custom properties to change typography or palette; self-hosted fonts, no Google Fonts.

nodes.label: Pending Items (logo, palette confirmation, address, hours, photos, domain)
nodes.norm_label: pending items (logo, palette confirmation, address, hours, photos, domain)

nodes.label: logo.svg (primary logo)
nodes.rationale: SVG preferred, or transparent PNG >= 1000 px wide.
